# Psalm 91 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 91:1 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Dweller in-shelter-of the-Most-High, in-shadow-of the-Almighty he-will-lodge.
- **LOGOS:** He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will abide in the shadow of the Almighty.
- **PNEUMA:** Whoever lives under the protection of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 91:2 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** I-will-say to-YHWH, 'My-refuge and-my-fortress, my-God I-will-trust in-him.'
- **LOGOS:** I will say to the LORD, "My refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust."
- **PNEUMA:** I will declare about the LORD: 'He is my safe place and my fortress — my God, and I trust him completely.'

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

- **EMET:** From-plague in-darkness that-walks, from-destruction that-devastates at-noon.
- **LOGOS:** nor the pestilence that stalks in darkness, nor the destruction that wastes at noonday.
- **PNEUMA:** or disease creeping through the darkness, or disaster striking at noon.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 91:7 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Will-fall at-your-side a-thousand, and-ten-thousand at-your-right-hand; to-you not it-will-approach.
- **LOGOS:** A thousand may fall at your side, ten thousand at your right hand, but it will not come near you.
- **PNEUMA:** Even if a thousand people fall beside you — ten thousand at your right — it won't touch you.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

- **LOGOS:** You will only look with your eyes and see the recompense of the wicked.
- **PNEUMA:** Just open your eyes and watch — you'll see how the wicked are repaid.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 91:9 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** For you YHWH my-refuge — the-Most-High you-have-made your-dwelling.
- **LOGOS:** Because you have made the LORD your dwelling place — the Most High, who is my refuge —
- **PNEUMA:** Because you've made the LORD your home — the Most High your dwelling place —
